2022Q1.ai_dc_notes: Record orders led by logic/foundry; strong momentum also in memory and power/analog/wafer.

2022Q2.ai_dc_notes: Record orders EUR943m (+73% cc), boosted by new-node logic/foundry spending and memory wins (ALD gap-fill 3D-NAND, HKMG in DRAM); led by foundry, then memory, then logic.

2022Q3.ai_dc_notes: Q3 bookings and backlog reduced to remove China orders hit by Oct-7-2022 US export rules (China = 16% of 9M22 revenue); initial impact estimate >=40% of China sales (cut to 15-25% on 2022-11-28).

2022Q4.ai_dc_notes: Bookings EUR829m: steady logic/foundry demand plus record power/analog bookings, partly from LPE (exceptional SiC-epi orders, some for H2 2023 delivery).

2023Q1.ai_dc_notes: Orders softened toward quarter-end; memory demand weakened further and expected to stay low; push-outs in leading-edge logic/foundry (softer end markets, fab-readiness delays) to hit Q2-Q3 orders.

2023Q2.ai_dc_notes: Order trough EUR486m (-48% yoy): leading-edge logic/foundry push-outs and backlog normalization after supply-chain easing.

2023Q3.ai_dc_notes: Orders EUR627m despite weak market; first meaningful GAA orders (expected Q4) partly booked in Q3.

2023Q4.ai_dc_notes: Bookings EUR678m slightly above expectations, driven by GAA pilot-line orders and continued strong China demand.

2024Q1.ai_dc_notes: Orders +10% cc supported by GAA 2nm orders and a strong increase in memory orders, mainly HBM-related DRAM.

2024Q2.ai_dc_notes: Orders EUR755m (+56% cc) mainly driven by GAA and HBM demand.

2024Q3.ai_dc_notes: Headline: 'AI-related demand drives robust growth in bookings and revenue'; orders +30% on GAA and HBM; China sales expected lower in H2 2024 and moderately lower in H1 2025; FY2025 revenue EUR3.2-3.6bn.

2024Q4.ai_dc_notes: Orders +8% on GAA and HBM DRAM; GAA orders up strongly q/q but offset by drop in China demand; healthy 2025 memory sales expected on HBM-related DRAM.

2025Q1.ai_dc_notes: Orders EUR834m (+14% cc) on strong GAA 2nm orders, HBM-related DRAM and solid China; tariff uncertainty -> switch to growth-rate guidance (FY2025 +10-20% cc).

2025Q2.ai_dc_notes: Orders EUR703m: lower advanced logic/foundry orders due to timing; yoy decline vs high memory contribution in Q2 2024; H2 2025 ~ H1.

2025Q3.ai_dc_notes: Orders EUR637m (-17% cc): drop mainly China after strong H1; advanced logic/foundry orders up q/q but below initial expectations (see 2025-09-23 warning).

2025Q4.ai_dc_notes: Orders EUR803m rebound: leading-edge logic/foundry plus quarter-end China recovery; 2026: logic/foundry strongest on AI-related demand, 1.4nm pilot lines in H2 2026, healthy DRAM growth; quarterly bookings disclosure discontinued from Q1 2026.

2026Q1.ai_dc_notes: AI-led demand accelerated further (customer capacity investment for AI infrastructure); leading-edge strength plus strong rebound in mature logic/foundry sales in China; macro caution (Middle East conflict, energy prices).

2026Q2.ai_dc_notes: Record revenue EUR1,003m; AI momentum building; share gains in leading-edge logic/foundry, robust HBM DRAM growth, solid mature-node China; strong H1 order intake -> 2027 revenue expected above top of EUR3.7-4.6bn range.
